items.title: Higgsfield Debuts 'Kök Börü', Showcasing Hybrid Human-AI Animation Pipeline
items.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026, AI video platform Higgsfield premiered Kök Börü, a 15-minute animated short pairing generative AI with hand-drawn digital animation. Character sheets and environments were generated in Higgsfield's Soul Cartoon (trained on an NVIDIA B300 cluster) then enhanced by artists on Wacom tablets, cutting a 1-2 year, $1-2M production down to about two weeks.

items.title: Oscar-Qualifying Bengaluru International Short Film Festival Expands to 10 Arenas, Adds AI and Dance Competitions
items.excerpt: India's Oscar-qualifying Bengaluru International Short Film Festival is expanding its 16th edition to 10 arenas of cinema, adding a dedicated AI-made films competition category — a signal of AI filmmaking moving into mainstream festival programming.

items.title: Orange County 48-Hour Film Challenge Comes to Brea
items.excerpt: Film Lab 714's OC Film Workshop and 48-Hour Film Challenge (Aug 18-20, Brea, CA) includes sessions on visual effects and generative AI, framing how emerging tools can support production while keeping human creativity at the center of the filmmaking process.

items.title: Vecna, Demogorgons and Young Will: Inside the VFX of Stranger Things S5
items.excerpt: The Stranger Things S5 VFX team weighed AI/ML face replacement from ILM and Weta FX for young Will's de-aging scenes, but ultimately chose a fully traditional CG face for the creative control it gave the Duffers when specific adjustments were needed — a candid look at where neural de-aging still loses to hand-crafted VFX.

items.title: Is this the future of filmmaking?
items.excerpt: A look at Beeble's hybrid pipeline, where real actors are captured traditionally, then AI tools SwitchX (video-to-video) and SwitchLight (relighting, material extraction) reshape environments and lighting in post. The takeaway: 'the AI result is a pass, not a result,' feeding into Nuke or DaVinci compositing rather than replacing it.

items.title: FrostFX: Estonia's world-leading VFX studio
items.excerpt: Profile of Estonian studio FrostFX, which treats AI as a creative tool to strip out repetitive technical work rather than replace artists — running models continuously for inference, training and asset generation, exemplified by 'Nova on Mars,' an AI-native character that generates content in real time.

items.title: This New AI Tool Can Trace Which AI Model Generated a Video
items.excerpt: UC Riverside researchers built SAGA (Source Attribution of Generative AI Videos), which identifies not just whether a video is AI-generated but which model made it, by detecting the distinctive visual 'fingerprints' each generative model leaves behind — a provenance tool for a filmmaking world flooded with synthetic footage.
